title: Provide unique icons for each wallpaper plugin
line: The Haenau, Hunyango and Tiled wallpaper plugins now each have their own icon instead of the same generic wallpaper icon.
explanation: The metadata of the Haenau, Hunyango and Tiled wallpaper plugins all set Icon to preferences-desktop-wallpaper, the same icon the Image plugin uses, so wherever plugin icons are shown (Discover/AppStream metainfo, plugin lists) they looked identical. The change points each one at a distinct existing Breeze icon: preferences-desktop-effects for the animated Haenau, preferences-desktop-display-color for the colour-shifting Hunyango and preferences-desktop-virtual (a grid of tiles) for Tiled.

commits.message:
wallpapers: give Haenau, Hunyango and Tiled their own icons

These three plugins all used the same generic wallpaper icon as the Image
plugin, so they could not be told apart wherever plugin icons are shown.
Use distinct existing Breeze icons that hint at what each one does.

BUG: 432840

media.caption: Installed wallpaper plugins with their metadata icons: Haenau, Hunyango, Image and Tiled share one icon
After: every wallpaper plugin has its own icon

review.text: Updating Haenau, Hunyango, and Tiled metadata.json files to use distinct existing Breeze preferences icons gives every shipped Plasma wallpaper plugin a unique icon, matching how Plain Color, Picture of the Day, Slideshow, and Image already reuse standard Breeze icons. The chosen icons visually fit each plugin and are properly picked up by AppStream metadata generation. Before/after verification cleanly confirms all seven plugins are distinguishable.

reviews.text: Updating Haenau, Hunyango, and Tiled metadata.json files to use distinct existing Breeze preferences icons gives every shipped Plasma wallpaper plugin a unique icon, matching how Plain Color, Picture of the Day, Slideshow, and Image already reuse standard Breeze icons. The chosen icons visually fit each plugin and are properly picked up by AppStream metadata generation. Before/after verification cleanly confirms all seven plugins are distinguishable.

The direction is right and the diff matches the description, but the chosen icons are borrowed from unrelated System Settings pages: preferences-desktop-effects is the Desktop Effects KCM, preferences-desktop-display-color is Night Light/display colour and preferences-desktop-virtual is Virtual Desktops. In Discover a Hunyango wallpaper showing the Night Light icon or Tiled showing the Virtual Desktops icon is misleading, and VDG generally rejects reusing an icon whose meaning is already taken. The evidence is a home-made QML viewer; no real Plasma UI (Discover/KNewStuff) was shown before or after.
changes: Use icons that actually represent each wallpaper: either new dedicated Breeze icons (requested from the VDG/breeze-icons) or package-local icons/preview images, rather than KCM icons with an established different meaning.
Show the result where users actually see it (Discover or the Get New Wallpaper Plugins dialog), not only in a custom metadata viewer.
